schema.text: Which of these do you find on your walking route? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Steps or steep curbs without ramps
Dropped kerbs at crossings missing or broken
Paths too narrow for a wheelchair, pushchair or two people to pass
Tactile paving for people with visual impairments missing or broken
Low branches or bushes taking up space
Stairs as the only way through, or stairways closed
Stretches with no sidewalk, so you have to walk in the road
Pedestrian traffic lights out of order
Pedestrian traffic lights without an audible signal

it.#Which of these do you find on your walk: Quali di queste cose trovi sul tuo percorso a piedi? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#Steps or steep curbs without ramps: Gradini o cordoli alti senza rampe
it.#Dropped kerbs at crossings missing or b: Scivoli dei marciapiedi agli attraversamenti mancanti o rotti
it.#Paths too narrow for a wheelchair, push: Passaggi troppo stretti per una sedia a rotelle, un passeggino o due persone
it.#Tactile paving for people with visual i: Percorsi tattili per persone con disabilità visiva mancanti o rotti
it.#Low branches or bushes taking up space: Rami bassi o cespugli che occupano spazio
it.#Stairs as the only way through, or stai: Scale come unico passaggio, oppure scalinate chiuse
it.#Stretches with no sidewalk, so you have: Tratti senza marciapiede, dove devi camminare sulla strada

fr.#Which of these do you find on your walk: Lesquelles de ces choses trouvez-vous sur votre trajet à pied ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#Steps or steep curbs without ramps: Des marches ou des bordures hautes sans rampe
fr.#Dropped kerbs at crossings missing or b: Des bateaux de trottoir aux passages piétons manquants ou abîmés
fr.#Paths too narrow for a wheelchair, push: Des passages trop étroits pour un fauteuil roulant, une poussette ou deux personnes
fr.#Tactile paving for people with visual i: Des bandes podotactiles pour les personnes malvoyantes manquantes ou abîmées
fr.#Low branches or bushes taking up space: Des branches basses ou des buissons qui prennent de la place
fr.#Stairs as the only way through, or stai: Des escaliers comme seul passage possible, ou des escaliers fermés
fr.#Stretches with no sidewalk, so you have: Des tronçons sans trottoir, où il faut marcher sur la chaussée
fr.#Pedestrian traffic lights out of order: Des feux pour piétons en panne

de.#Which of these do you find on your walk: Was davon finden Sie auf Ihrem Fußweg? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#Steps or steep curbs without ramps: Stufen oder hohe Bordsteine ohne Rampen
de.#Dropped kerbs at crossings missing or b: Abgesenkte Bordsteine an Überwegen fehlen oder sind beschädigt
de.#Paths too narrow for a wheelchair, push: Wege, die für einen Rollstuhl, einen Kinderwagen oder zwei Personen zu schmal sind
de.#Tactile paving for people with visual i: Blindenleitsysteme für sehbehinderte Menschen fehlen oder sind beschädigt
de.#Low branches or bushes taking up space: Tiefe Äste oder Büsche, die Platz wegnehmen
de.#Stairs as the only way through, or stai: Treppen als einziger Durchgang oder gesperrte Treppen
de.#Stretches with no sidewalk, so you have: Abschnitte ohne Gehweg, auf denen man auf der Fahrbahn gehen muss

tr.#Which of these do you find on your walk: Yürüme güzergâhınızda bunlardan hangileri var? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#Steps or steep curbs without ramps: Rampası olmayan basamaklar veya yüksek kaldırım kenarları
tr.#Dropped kerbs at crossings missing or b: Geçitlerdeki kaldırım rampaları eksik veya bozuk
tr.#Paths too narrow for a wheelchair, push: Tekerlekli sandalye, bebek arabası veya iki kişinin geçemeyeceği kadar dar yollar
tr.#Tactile paving for people with visual i: Görme engelli kişiler için hissedilebilir yüzeyler eksik veya bozuk
tr.#Low branches or bushes taking up space: Yer kaplayan alçak dallar veya çalılar
tr.#Stairs as the only way through, or stai: Tek geçiş yolunun merdivenler olması ya da kapalı merdivenler
tr.#Stretches with no sidewalk, so you have: Kaldırımın olmadığı ve yolda yürümek zorunda kalınan kesimler
tr.#Pedestrian traffic lights without an au: Sesli sinyali olmayan yaya trafik ışıkları

fa.#Which of these do you find on your walk: کدام یک از این موارد را در مسیر پیاده‌روی خود می‌بینید؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#Steps or steep curbs without ramps: پله یا جدول بلند بدون رمپ
fa.#Dropped kerbs at crossings missing or b: نبود یا خرابی شیب‌راهه جدول در گذرگاه‌ها
fa.#Paths too narrow for a wheelchair, push: مسیرهایی که برای ویلچر، کالسکه یا عبور دو نفر باریک‌اند
fa.#Tactile paving for people with visual i: نبود یا خرابی کفپوش لمسی برای افراد کم‌بینا یا نابینا
fa.#Low branches or bushes taking up space: شاخه‌های آویزان یا بوته‌هایی که فضای عبور را گرفته‌اند
fa.#Stairs as the only way through, or stai: پله به‌عنوان تنها مسیر عبور، یا پلکان بسته
fa.#Stretches with no sidewalk, so you have: بخش‌هایی بدون پیاده‌رو که مجبور می‌شوید در سوارهٔ خیابان راه بروید
fa.#Pedestrian traffic lights without an au: چراغ‌های راهنمای عابر پیاده بدون علامت صوتی

hu.#Which of these do you find on your walk: Melyekkel találkozik a gyalogos útvonalán? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#Steps or steep curbs without ramps: Lépcsők vagy magas szegélyek rámpa nélkül
hu.#Dropped kerbs at crossings missing or b: Hiányzó vagy sérült süllyesztett szegélyek az átkelőhelyeknél
hu.#Paths too narrow for a wheelchair, push: Túl keskeny szakaszok, ahol nem fér el egy kerekesszék vagy babakocsi, vagy két ember nem tud elmenni egymás mellett
hu.#Tactile paving for people with visual i: Hiányzó vagy sérült taktilis burkolat a látássérült emberek számára
hu.#Low branches or bushes taking up space: Útba lógó alacsony ágak vagy bokrok
hu.#Stairs as the only way through, or stai: A lépcső az egyetlen átjárási lehetőség, vagy le vannak zárva a lépcsők
hu.#Stretches with no sidewalk, so you have: Járda nélküli szakaszok, ahol az úttesten kell mennie

ar.#Which of these do you find on your walk: أي من هذه الأمور تجده على مسار مشيك؟ (يمكن اختيار كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#Steps or steep curbs without ramps: درجات أو أرصفة مرتفعة بلا منحدرات
ar.#Dropped kerbs at crossings missing or b: غياب منحدرات الأرصفة عند المعابر أو تلفها
ar.#Paths too narrow for a wheelchair, push: ممرات ضيقة جدًا لا تتسع لكرسي متحرك أو عربة أطفال أو لمرور شخصين
ar.#Tactile paving for people with visual i: غياب البلاط اللمسي للأشخاص ذوي الإعاقة البصرية أو تلفه
ar.#Low branches or bushes taking up space: أغصان أو شجيرات منخفضة تشغل المساحة
ar.#Stairs as the only way through, or stai: سلالم هي الطريق الوحيد، أو سلالم مغلقة
ar.#Stretches with no sidewalk, so you have: مقاطع بلا رصيف تضطر فيها إلى المشي في الطريق
ar.#Pedestrian traffic lights without an au: إشارات مرور للمشاة دون إشارة صوتية
